metadata.description: When a Claude Code chat gets long, Cornerman saves a handover, clears the chat and carries on by itself, up to the number of clears you set. Tables, lists, links and paths from the cleared chat stay one click away.

plugins.name: cornerman
plugins.description: When a Claude Code chat gets long, Cornerman saves a handover, clears the chat and carries on by itself, up to the number of clears you set. Tables, lists, links and paths from the cleared chat stay one click away. Shares its store with the cornerman VS Code extension.
